messages:
Anjali Rao: FYI nightly eval flagged a sizable regression on rdx-llama3-70b using INT8-profile-v4 for the summarization prompt set. ROUGE-L down ~12% vs FP16 baseline. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/evals/1792000000 :eyes:

EvalBot: [alert] nightly-eval/rdx-llama3-70b/int8-v4 — metric_drop=rouge_l:-11.8%; failed_prompts=23; run_id=1792000000

Mike Chen: Can you paste one failing example (input + fp16 vs int8 outputs)? Also what sequence length distribution for those prompts?

Anjali Rao: Example below. Most failures at seq_len > 1024.

```
INPUT: "Summarize this meeting: long transcript... (trimmed)"
FP16 OUTPUT: "Key points: ... decision to move to quarterly review, owners: alice, bob."
INT8-v4 OUTPUT: "In summary: the company will acquire from competitors, confidential plan to layoff, contact legal."  <-- hallucination and wrong entities
```

Cheng Wu: Hmm that's not just formatting noise; hallucinated facts. I pulled quant calibration dumps for int8-v4 — per-layer scale shift in layers 20-24 (+18% mean scale) compared to int8-v3. Could be a calibration mismatch after we updated the per-channel optimizer last week.

Tara Simmons: We did flip an AVX->AMX kernel selection flag in runtime on 2026-03-18 for efficiency. That can change rounding patterns. Patch: runtime/fastkernels #892. Could be interacting with per-channel quantization.

Mike Chen: Repro steps I'm going to run now (on dedicated pool with deterministic seeds):
```
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model rdx-llama3-70b --profile int8-v4 --promptset summarization-long --seed 42 --max-len 1536 --save-outputs /tmp/int8-v4-179200
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model rdx-llama3-70b --profile fp16 --promptset summarization-long --seed 42 --max-len 1536 --save-outputs /tmp/fp16-179200
```
I'll diff outputs and sample perplexity.

EvalBot: repro-job queued -> job_id=eval-179200-33; node=dedi-3; ETA ~14m

Cheng Wu: I'll extract per-layer scale histograms + calibration matrices (quant-stats tool) and compare int8-v3 vs int8-v4. Quick check: run `python -m quantstats.compare --runs /path/to/dumps --layers 18-26`

Tara Simmons: I'll try forcing the old kernel selection (AMX off) to see if regression disappears: `RUNTIME_FORCE_KERNEL=avx ./scripts/run_eval.sh ...` If that fixes it, we know it's kernel interaction.

Anjali Rao: If repro confirms, propose immediate rollback of int8-profile-v4 to v3 for production until we root-cause. Also creating an internal ticket: INF-4821.

Mike Chen: Quick update — first batch done, reproducible on dedi-3. Raw diffs show 19 of the 23 failing prompts produced hallucinated claims only under int8-v4. Collecting full metric table and will upload to the ticket. :hammer:

Cheng Wu: Preliminary quantstats show a shift in scale distribution for key attention matrices when running with the new per-channel optimizer. Attaching summary: mean_scale_delta=+0.18; affected_layers=[20,21,22,23]; kl_divergence_on_logits=0.07

Tara Simmons: I ran with AMX disabled for a subset — hallucinations disappear for those prompts. Kernel seems to affect numerical stability with this profile.

Anjali Rao: Good signal chain. Next actions: Mike - full eval + upload diffs (ETA 2h). Cheng - dig into per-layer calibration and try re-calibrating int8-v4 with the old optimizer seed (ETA 4h). Tara - open runtime rollback PR and test perf impact (ETA 1h). I'll coordinate with support to throttle int8-v4 rollout and add canary rule to route summarization workloads to fp16 or int8-v3.

Mike Chen: adding note to ticket: reproduce commands, failing sample ids, diffs, and perf tradeoffs.

EvalBot: ticket INF-4821 created by Anjali Rao; watchers: Mike Chen, Cheng Wu, Tara Simmons, infra-oncall.

Anjali Rao: Thanks team — keep updates in this thread. If anyone finds a quick mitigant (force fp16 per-route / rollback profile), do it and ping #eng-oncall. :zap:
